Intro: Privet, honourable cook. Why the long face? Can't a nurse catch a break after a war? Niet.
This land is long dead, and any desire to pick at its roots rot away faster than the cruel bastards who toil in them. In this world, I am no one.
Give me [DISH] and I'll be on my way. You have people to serve, and I have men to bandage.
Success: Oh… Mama… I have not tasted a meal of this…substance, since… I– I must leave– important matters– no offense.
Fail: This meal is terrible. It is my fault for expecting anything out of this… imitation of the past. We will not see each other again. Proshchaniye.
Reject: I leave my post for one moment and I– Dammit.
